KC's early game runs through Canna and Yike (Vi 8-3); C9's jungler Blaber is the weakest early-game stat line of the four Play-In junglers on record (XPD@15 -496, CSD@15 -6.4).

C9 lean on Blaber Nocturne (2-0) but Nocturne is a top-2 ban everywhere. Fearless Bo5 tests C9's thinner sampled pools (>=8 champions per player in an 11-game sample) more than KC's 13-19.
series.form_context: KC: 9-0 Summer regular season, then 1-3 G2 and 0-3 MSI in playoffs (1-6 in games), but EWC runner-up in July and 5-4 in 2026 international series. C9: 8-7 in Summer playoffs, ended with back-to-back 1-3 losses (TLAW, LYON). No 2026 head-to-head.
series.what_flips: KC's baron control collapses internationally (26%). If C9 survive lane and drag games past 30 minutes, Vulcan's playmaking (KDA 7.3, 81.7% KP) and C9's 56% dragon / 60% herald control can win the long game, plus a home crowd in LA.

qf.draft_angle: DK ban Nocturne 100% and Kalista 44%; opponents ban Vi 56% and Orianna 44% vs DK. BLG's top-lane comforts (Renekton/Gnar/K'Sante) face K'Sante's 26.20 nerf.

qf.what_flips: DK's poor conversion (46.2% WR when ahead @15). If BLG stay close at 15, BLG's late teamfighting ('most lethal teamfight roster') is the better closing tool.

qf.what_flips: If AL's early snowball lands (Grand Final wins at 30-31 minutes with 18-8, 20-1, 22-5 kill leads), T1's slow-start profile is exactly what loses Bo5s.

final.key_matchup: Mid: Chovy vs Faker. GEN's macro control (61.7% dragon, 74.2% Nashor) against T1's late-game teamfighting (Peyz pentakill G1 vs DK).

finals_mvp.reason: Gen.G's win condition is Ruler as the carry (31.7% damage, 25.4% gold share in LCK playoffs) and he was LCK Finals MVP on 13/09/2026. Chovy is the close alternative.

single_biggest_risk.assumption: That the LCK is clearly the strongest region (+0.39 logit over the LPL after temperature scaling, worth about 60-40 per game between equal teams) and Gen.G its best team. Four of the model's top five and the predicted champion depend on it, yet LCK vs LPL was only 5-5 in 2026 series and Gen.G's own international record (0-3 G2, 1-2 DK) was weak.
single_biggest_risk.early_detection: Watch LCK vs LPL results in Swiss rounds 1-3 (Bo1s from 23/10). If LPL teams win the majority of those cross-region matches, and/or Gen.G drops a Bo1 to a Tier 4 team, the region gap is overstated and the staged Swiss/Knockout re-run should shrink it.

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest presence?
crystal_ball.reason: 85.6% presence across 298 domestic playoff games (77% ban rate). The 26.20 nerf is to base HP and mana; she could lose 20+ points and still lead Vi (63.1%). Alternative: Vi (71.8% at MSI).

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest win rate (min 5 games)?
crystal_ball.reason: 60.0% WR (27-18) domestically as a top/support flex, so it reaches 5 games; Qiyana (59.6%) is the alternative Hotspawn tips. High-variance question.

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest average deaths (min 5 games)?
crystal_ball.reason: Engage supports die most; Nautilus is the most-picked pure engage support (35.9% presence) and leads LEC supports. Alternative: Alistar.

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average KDA?
crystal_ball.reason: KDA 7.3 in LCK playoffs on the team the model rates best and most likely to play the most games (lower variance). Alternatives: Knight (7.2 at MSI), Vulcan (7.3, but in the Play-In).

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average damage per game?
crystal_ball.reason: 31.7% damage share, the highest of any Worlds ADC in the samples, on a team that plays controlled longer games. Alternative: Viper.

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average kill participation?
crystal_ball.reason: 83.3% KP in LCK playoffs, highest of the LCK playoff samples. Alternatives: Vulcan (81.7%), Career (80.6%).

crystal_ball.question: Peyz vs Gumayusi: more total kills?
crystal_ball.reason: Total kills depend on games played: model gives T1 a slightly deeper run (P semis 55% vs 49%), and Peyz takes more of his team's gold/damage (26.2% gold, 30.3% DMG vs 24.6%/27.5%).

crystal_ball.question: Will Faker reach 700 career Worlds kills this year?
crystal_ball.reason: Needs 84 kills from 616. Even a maximum-length run is ~26 games, needing 3.2+ kills a game; his LCK playoff KDA was 3.0 on a team with -468 GD@15.

crystal_ball.question: Will Teemo be picked at least once?
crystal_ball.reason: No Teemo in the 298-game domestic playoff sample or the 71-game MSI sample.

crystal_ball.question: How many unique champions will be picked?
crystal_ball.reason: Fearless Draft in every Bo3/Bo5 forces breadth; the domestic sample already shows deep pools. Exact answer bands UNKNOWN until seen in client.

crystal_ball.question: Will more games end before or after 32:00?
crystal_ball.reason: Mean length is 32:34 domestically and 32:32 at MSI, but game length is right-skewed, so the median (which decides 'more games') sits below the mean.

crystal_ball.question: Will any pro get 15+ kills in one game?
crystal_ball.reason: Nobody passed 14 kills in a 2025 Worlds game (Hotspawn). Fearless reduces one-sided comfort stomps late in series.

crystal_ball.question: Will any pro reach 450+ CS in one game?
crystal_ball.reason: Needs roughly a 45+ minute game for a mid or ADC (~10 CS/min, e.g. Hope 9.9 CSM). Gen.G alone had a 52-minute game vs DK at EWC; across ~100 Worlds games at least one game of that length is more likely than not.

How many different regions will be in Knockouts?
Will a team from the LCS reach Knockouts?
crystal_ball.reason: Model: 66% that at least one of TLAW, LYON, C9 reaches the quarterfinals (home-crowd adjustment included).

crystal_ball.question: Which team places higher: HLE or T1?
crystal_ball.reason: Model: T1 higher 49%, HLE higher 41%, same placement 10%. Depends on the +0.20 T1 adjustment; without it this flips.

crystal_ball.question: Which team will win the shortest game?
crystal_ball.reason: Most aggressive early-game top team (76.5% first blood) and had MSI 2026's fastest game (22:16, Hotspawn). Shortest games come from strong teams beating Play-In/Tier 4 teams in Bo1s.
